target_customer: European e-commerce brands needing same-day and sustainable last-mile delivery
problem: Last-mile delivery is the most expensive and polluting leg of e-commerce; Blink used cargo bikes, electric vehicles and minimal packaging.
business_model: Delivery as a service charged per parcel to e-commerce brands

founders.name: Jacopo Berlusconi
founders.background_notes: Energy engineer, sales and partnerships, per the YC page.

founders.name: Marco Boretto
founders.background_notes: Operations and product development per the YC page.

founders.name: Marco Turetta
founders.background_notes: Computer engineer with over 7 years at startups and large companies, leads product and technology, per the YC page.

competitors.name: Milkman
competitors.what: Milan-based last-mile delivery platform with a Poste Italiane partnership for special deliveries
competitors.funding_then: Raised 25 million euros from Poste Italiane, P101, 500 Startups, Vertis and 360 Capital in May 2020

technical_complexity.rationale: Routing and a delivery operations platform are standard; the hard part was running a courier network.

defensibility.rationale: Couriers and cargo bikes are commodity inputs and well funded rivals existed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source describes an incumbent copying or buying Blink.

market_need_then: E-commerce volumes in Italy rose in 2020 and urban emissions rules pushed sustainable delivery; Forbes Italia in March 2021 described Blink delivering thousands of parcels daily, as per its search snippet.

branding.domain_note: blinklastmile.com, a name plus descriptor domain
branding.community_and_virality: Covered by Forbes Italia in March 2021 after winning the PoliHub Switch2Product competition.

brand_strength.rationale: Short evocative name for speed, but shared with Blink Charging, Blink Health and others, and no brand assets were found.

outcome_analysis: Blink started delivering in Milan in April 2020, won a PoliHub competition and entered YC in Winter 2021 with a small seed of about $130K. PitchBook lists it as out of business on 2025-11-29 with $163K raised, but no founder statement or report explains the cause, so it is not public. Small capital against a courier operation is a plausible factor but is not sourced.
notes: The seed rests on one aggregator (startupintros); PitchBook total is $163K and another source says $120K total. The shutdown date rests on PitchBook alone. Forbes Italia (403 on fetch) and company site (did not resolve) were not read directly, so Forbes details come from search snippets only. An Andersen item about a Blink S.r.l. in 2025 could not be tied to this company. Milkman source date is May 2020, before the batch.
